The most recently merged pull request in firecrawl/cli is **#319, "revert: documentation research and workflow setup (#318)"**. It was merged about 6 hours ago, on Oct 16, 2026, and was opened by Max17190.

It reverts #318, "feat(skills): improve documentation research and workflow setup", which was merged earlier the same day. A revert can only land after the PR it undoes, so #319 comes after #318.

I got this from the scraped list of merged PRs, which GitHub orders by creation date rather than merge date. I haven't checked whether an older, lower-numbered PR was merged after #319. That's unlikely, since the next most recent merges in the list (#317, #310 and #311) were 2 to 3 days ago.

The GitHub API and `gh` weren't available in this session. I read the public PR list through the Firecrawl CLI instead.
